title: Mt.FUJI 100 — RACE INFORMATION (2027, 23-25 April)
claims: The 2027 Mt.FUJI100 runs from 23 to 25 April 2027, and the FUJI100mi covers 165.3 km with 6,463 m of accumulated elevation gain.
The FUJI100mi starts at Mount Fuji Children's World (Fuji City, Shizuoka Prefecture) and finishes at Fuji Hokuroku Park Fujisan GX Stadium (Fujiyoshida City, Yamanashi Prefecture).

The 2027 FUJI100mi starts in three waves on 23 April at 17:00, 17:15 and 17:30, each of approximately 700 runners, with limits of 45 hours 30 minutes, 45 hours 15 minutes and 45 hours respectively; the final cut-off is 25 April at 14:30.
The 2027 FUJI100mi recruitment is 2,000 people including priority, general and donation entries, and 500 support staff.
The 2027 KAI70k covers 67.9 km with 2,917 m of gain, starts and finishes at Fuji Hokuroku Park, starts on 24 April at 14:00 and has a 21-hour limit ending 25 April at 11:00.
The 2027 ASUMI40k covers approximately 38.5 km with 1,481 m of gain, starts and finishes at Fuji Hokuroku Park, starts on 24 April at 12:00 and has a 9-hour 30-minute limit ending 24 April at 21:30.
The 2027 page lists the FUJI100mi as a World Trail Majors eligible race, a Western States Endurance Run 2028 qualifying race and an ITRA National League race.

The event is organised by the Mt.FUJI100 Executive Committee, with Fuji City, Fujinomiya City, Minobu Town, Narusawa Village, Fujikawaguchiko Town, Fujiyoshida City, Oshino Village, Yamanakako Village, Gotemba City and Susono City as co-organisers.

The English version of the same page misstates several dates and times: it gives the KAI70k start as 'April 4th (Sat) 24:14', the ASUMI40k final deadline as 'April 4th (Saturday) 24:21' and the FUJI100mi final deadline as 'February 4 (Sun) 25:14', all of which contradict the Japanese page.
